judged_text: Pagination math in totalPages produces an empty phantom last page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (should use Math.ceil instead of Math.floor + 1); currentPage has the same flaw

record.issue_text: Pagination math in totalPages produces an empty phantom last page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (should use Math.ceil instead of Math.floor + 1); currentPage has the same flaw

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` and `currentPage` as `Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50), `totalPages` becomes 3 instead of 2, creating a phantom last page. This is reachable because the `next` action sets `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, allowing `offset == user_count`, and then `group.findMembers()` will request that offset and can return an empty member list while `currentPage` shows the extra page. Using `Math.ceil(user_count/limit)` (and clamping `offset` to `user_count - limit`) would avoid this.
